newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Parliament votes state of emergency in Albania.
newsitem.headline: Parliament votes state of emergency in Albania.

text.p: Parliament voted to declare an immediate state of emergency throughout Albania on Sunday in response to riots rocking the nation, the speaker of the chamber announced.

The Speaker, Pjeter Arbnori, told the assembly the measure took effect at 1635 GMT after a 118-0 vote in favour in the parliament, which is almost entirely controlled by President Sali Berisha's Democratic Party.

The special session was held after fresh anti-government disturbances erupted in southern Albania despite Berisha's dismissal on Saturday of Prime Minister Aleksander Meksi's deeply unpopular government.

The full effect of the state of emergency was not immediately clear. The state-run news agency ATA said parliament would discuss merging the country's Shik secret police and Interior Ministry to "crush" rebellion.
Albania, Europe's poorest state, has been battered by unrest since dubious pyramid investment schemes began to collapse in January. Many savers blame Berisha's Democratic Party for their misery.
